suggestions.description: Replace string concatenation with SQL parameter binding
suggestions.before: const sql = `SELECT * FROM todos WHERE text LIKE '%${query}%'`
suggestions.after: const sql = `SELECT * FROM todos WHERE text LIKE ?`; db.query(sql, [query])
suggestions.benefits: Prevents SQL injection, better database performance
